claims.content: If the previous action was not an 'undo' action (e.g., it was a redo or a new block movement), the system displays the board in the state prior to that last action.
If the previous action *was* an 'undo' action, then performing another 'undo' will restore the state before the original movement that was undone (effectively acting as a 'redo' of the undo).
If there was no previous movement to undo (i.e., the game has just started or all movements have been undone), the 'Undo' action is unavailable and cannot be selected.
